summary.en: Follows a numbered tender: the brief recapped, the design answered clause by clause, optional chapters only when the brief asks for them, and a clause response table.
summary.zh: 跟随有编号条款的招标：复述需求，逐条回应设计条款；只有 brief 要求时才出现可选章节；附条款回应表。

chapters.purpose: Proposal title, the lead render, client and event.
The project and the event recapped, the stand space (optionally pack/site.svg), the requirements in plain words.
The concept or concepts, plans, annotated views and one page or group per design clause, in clause order.
Only when the brief has interaction clauses or deliverables: what visitors do, the content, the route through it.
Only when the brief asks for graphics: one page per requested graphic, the chosen graphic render with its text set over the empty area (layout graphic).
Only when the brief has execution or price clauses or deliverables: one page with the fixed sentence and the list of items submitted separately; no figures.
The response table (one row per clause and per deliverable with its pages; a long table may span two pages) and the items to confirm.
